memories.title: 楼幢维护详情项目链接路径错误误报无授权
memories.content: `楼幢维护`详情页「所属项目」链接传给`getRouterPathByFilePath()`的filePath为不存在的`projectManagement/project/customerProjectinfo/detail`，路由未匹配时于`src/utils/ruoyi.js:437`抛出“没有授权”异常（与权限无关）。修正路径为`projectManagement/customerProject/detail`（对应`src/views/projectManagement/customerProject/detail.vue`），涉及`src/views/projectManagement/buildinginfo/detail.vue:811`等4处。

memories.title: 企业资质要件回显兼容双列表去硬编码
memories.content: `src/utils/registerQualification.js`新增`extractQualificationListFromPayload`兼容`qualificationList`与`qualificationRecordList`，及`resolvePrimaryQualificationFromPayload`取首条有效资质。`DeveloperBasicInfoDetail.vue`的`detailCallback`优先从`getOwnCompany`的`data`/`companyRecord`解析资质，`licenseBusCode`改用`resolveLicenseAppendixBusCode(this.$route)`替换错误`'040100'`。
